optimization.note: Applies only to identical edits; not a reduction in full-loop successful composition cost.

limitations: Three seeds vary input data within one handcrafted parser family; not 300 independent real-world tasks.
No LLM inference, current Darwin optimizer comparison, dollars, or transfer improvement is measured.
Equal budget means seven logical operations, not equal provider cost or tokens.
All full reports and provenance are retained below; no confidence interval implies external generalization.

reports.claim: Offline parser mechanics only; not real LLM quality, current Darwin performance, or transfer evidence.

dataset.policy: Development selects candidates; heldout is scored only after selection.

latency.includes: Adapter execution, validation, hashing, receipts and scheduling; excludes build.

limitations: Handwritten proposers know two parser operations. They do not learn general-purpose skills.
Equal budget means 7 logical operations: 4 eight-row evaluations plus 3 candidate generations; all synthetic operations cost zero dollars, not equal real tokens or spend.
The repeated-sampling control may tie or beat the loop; no improvement threshold is asserted.
Same-process answer separation is a benchmark discipline, not isolation from malicious adapters.
Holdout generation uses the same two-feature distribution as development; external transfer is unmeasured.
No production promotion, network, shell command, provider call or secret access is performed by adapters.
